interpretation: Synthetic mechanics acceptance only; these cases do not estimate clinical accuracy, recall, calibration, or safety.

method.alignment: maximum-weight one-to-one Hungarian assignment with dummy abstention columns
method.calibration: none; no learned or gold-tuned threshold
method.complexity: O(total atom n-grams + candidate aggregation + sum_c S_c*(A+S_c)*S_c); no O(A^2) or O(A^3) finding construction
method.truth: six typed T/F/U gates plus prototype required_logic
method.weights: posting IDF affects candidate ordering only; card weights are not consumed by truth assignment; fixed ALL>GROUP>supportive feasibility tiers drive Hungarian alignment
method.write_policy: assert only when entailed; otherwise query-only abstention

normalized_cache_screen.interpretation: Load and fail-closed safety screen only. Missing subject/time/polarity/modality/specimen/quality fields are not imputed, so candidate retrieval cannot become a phenotype assertion. Counts are not precision, recall, or FPR.
